applies_to: Foreign nationals travelling to Kenya. This file does not rewrite passport-requirements/*.json; maintainers should apply route_defaults when updating those routes.

standard_eta.fee_note: Standard eTA fee is USD 30. Bank or card surcharges, if any, are extra and are not part of the government fee.
standard_eta.processing_note: Portal guidance is to apply at least 3 days before travel. Approval is sent by email. This is not an instant issuance product.
standard_eta.validity: 90 days from the date of issue, single entry, stay of up to 90 days
standard_eta.application_note: Use only the official portal above. Third-party sites that charge a handling fee on top of the USD 30 are not the government channel.

exemptions.note: Taken from the official eligibility page as published on the access date, including the categories added in the 2025 rule changes. Re-check https://etakenya.go.ke/eligibility before changing a route or before travel. This record does not reproduce gazette text.
exemptions.east_african_note: Citizens of these East African Partner States are exempt from the eTA. Travel on a national ID, where the EAC regime allows it, is a separate rule from the eTA and should stay on the passport/ID privilege record rather than be folded into the fee.
exemptions.not_listed_here: Somalia (SO) is an EAC member but is not recorded as eTA-exempt in this claim. Add SO only after the eligibility page names it.
additional_exempt_categories: Kenya permanent residents and holders of a valid Kenya work permit or pass
Holders of a valid Kenya re-entry pass
Transit passengers who remain airside and do not leave the airport
Airline or ship crew on duty and listed on the manifest
Private-aircraft crew on duty passing through Kenya
Holders of diplomatic or official passports travelling on official duty (by arrangement, not a blanket waiver)
Accompanied children under 16 years of age
